svg.title: Mengirim OTP lewat WhatsApp, Cek Verifikasi, lalu MFA
svg.desc: 1. Kirim apa adanya ke +6282125784683. Jangan ubah kodenya. 2. Kembali ke tab Scalev. 3. Klik Cek Verifikasi. Nomor jadi terverifikasi. 4. Nyalakan MFA: Profil, bagian Security. Ganti Email OTP ke Authenticator App.

g.text: Untuk komentar dan balasan baru di
By default, MFA method is using Email OTP, and you can switch to
use Authenticator App for better security. MFA is used for:
login, fund withdrawal, and change business owner.
